description: Dates and number formatting family (crates/twig-fuzz/src/gen/formats.rs): a systematic slice of formats::grid() (every 97th date case: all DateTimeInterface::format() characters for special instants in odd zones; every 20th interval case: all DateInterval::format() characters for differences of special instants), all identical to Twig 3.31.1 on PHP 8.5.13 when recorded
